info.name: Voice Agent - D16 P2 (transfer, hours, knowledge, SIP)
info.description:
D16 (P2): transfer billing, per-number business hours, knowledge use per call, SIP re-verify. ADR 0028.

## Ek line me
Transfer = do legs, do ledger rows (B) · har call me agent ne kya dhoonda (C) · number ke apne ghante + chhutiyan (D) · imported SIP trunk ka dobara check (E).

## Setup — 4 steps
**1. Dono files import karo** — collection **aur** `d16-p2.postman_environment.json`. Phir upar right me **"Voice Agent D16"** environment select karo (warna `{{api_base}}` resolve nahi hoga → `EAI_AGAIN`).

**2. Local stack chalao** (API + worker dono — worker ke bina webhook 200 dega par kuch bill nahi hoga):
```sh
pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:deploy && pnpm db:seed
pnpm dev            # api http://localhost:4000 + worker + portal http://localhost:3000
```

**3. Environment me 3–4 values bharo** (baaki folder A khud bharta hai):

| Variable | Kahan se |
| --- | --- |
| `api_base` | Default `http://localhost:4000` (staging par `https://api-staging.oraly.ai`) |
| `token` | Neeche "Token kaise laayein" |
| `retell_api_key` | `.env` ka `RETELL_API_KEY` — webhook signature isi se banta hai |
| `number_token` | Sirf folder D.6 ke liye (optional) — neeche SQL |
| `workspace_id`, `agent_id`, `to_number`, `number_id`, `sip_number_id` | **Khud bharte hain** (folder A.2, A.4) |

**4. Folder A → F order me chalao** (Runner bhi chalega). Koi bhi request akeli bhi chal jaati hai: collection ka pre-request script khali `workspace_id` / `agent_id` / `to_number` har request se pehle API se khud bhar deta hai. Koi value na bhar paaye to error me **wajah** likhi aati hai (jaise `GET /workspaces → 401` = token expire). Postman Console (neeche left) me `[auto-fill]` lines bhi dikhti hain.

## Token kaise laayein
Portal (`http://localhost:3000`) me owner/admin se login karo → browser DevTools (F12) → Console me ye chalao aur jo print ho use `token` me daalo:
```js
const k = Object.keys(localStorage).find((k) => k.startsWith('@@auth0spajs@@') && !k.includes('@@user@@'));
copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)).body.access_token); 'token copied'
```
Token kuch ghanton me expire hota hai — 401 aaye to dobara copy karo.

## number_token (sirf D.6)
API ye kabhi nahi deta (inbound webhook ka secret path hai). Local DB se:
```sh
PGPASSWORD=portal psql -h localhost -U portal -d portal -c "select e164, inbound_token from phone_numbers where tenant_id = '<workspace_id>' and status = 'active'"
```
`to_number` se match karta `inbound_token` hi daalna.

**Paisa:** folder B us workspace ke asli credits kaatta hai. Folder E platform par number ke SIP details dobara likhta hai — dev workspace par hi chalao. SIP ke liye `.env` me `SIP_CREDENTIALS_LOCAL_KEY` (64 hex, `openssl rand -hex 32`) chahiye, warna `503`.

item.description:
Imported SIP number (Option C) ke credentials dobara check karna — optional naye credentials ke saath. **Synchronous** hai jaan-boojh kar: naya password sirf request ke stack par rehta hai, kisi job payload (Redis) me nahi.

Local par `.env` me `SIP_CREDENTIALS_LOCAL_KEY` (64 hex) chahiye, warna `503 NOT_CONFIGURED`. Ek ghante me 10 checks per workspace (`429 RATE_LIMITED`).

request.description:
Owner/admin, email verified. Khali body = jo save hai wahi check karo.

Kya hota hai:
1. **Lease** (`sip_verify_started_at`) — ek number par ek waqt me ek hi check, doosra = `409 SIP_VERIFY_IN_PROGRESS`
2. **Trunk check** — ek SIP OPTIONS, digest auth ke saath stored username/password; sirf **public address** par (VPC/metadata/localhost kabhi nahi), port < 1024 refuse
3. **Platform** — trunk fail nahi hua to `get-phone-number` + `update-phone-number` (termination_uri + credentials) dobara bhejte hain
4. Result `sip.verification` me: `verified` / `warning` / `failed` + reason

Password kabhi response, log ya audit me nahi aata.
